services.desc: Last Cast Charters is dedicated to providing you with the best inshore fishing trip possible. We specialize in light tackle fishing for speckled trout, redfish, and flounder with both artificial and live bait. All our captains are great with kids and treat people the way we would want to be treated. Pricing: Rates are for up to 4 guests, but we can accommodate up to 6 in a single boat for an additional $100/additional guest. Larger groups are welcome to book, but please call for groups over 6 to ensure availability of multiple
